policy: Use Shirakawa alone. Prefer his later explanation when more helpful; weave illuminating earlier details into coherent English. Keep authorship and book comparisons outside the explanation. Romanized Japanese words mentioned in the prose use italic emphasis.
limits: The later-work evidence is reproduced attributed excerpts, not a reading of the complete printed books.
Surrounding criticism and other scholars’ interpretations were excluded.
Omitting an incidental previous detail does not establish that it is absent from all of Shirakawa’s writings.
